caption: The drawing depicts a metal object and a simple outline sketch on a plain, off-white background. The metal object, situated in the upper left quadrant, is elongated and rod-like, primarily colored in shades of brown and gray to indicate a metallic material. One end of the object is straight with a small, looped or bulbous tip, while the opposite end features two circular or oval loops, oriented perpendicularly to the rod and overlapping each other. Below and to the right of the metal object is a simple, incomplete outline rendered in a reddish-brown hue. The outline consists of a closed circular loop connected to an angled line, roughly mimicking the shape and orientation of the object above it. The artist's name, "Elizabeth Johnson," appears in small text in the lower left portion of the image. The composition is sparse, with significant empty space between the objects and around the edges.
title: Branding Iron
